notes: The Prozorro public API (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders) opened without a login. It returns only id and dateModified per tender and has no keyword, CPV or buyer filter. Finding NovaSeq awards would mean paging through every tender (millions) and fetching each one, which is not feasible with the tools available here. The prozorro.gov.ua site search is JavaScript-rendered and I could not reach it. Two web searches turned up no NovaSeq flow-cell or reagent tenders on Prozorro. The only Prozorro hits were UA-2024-04-25-004545-a (Okhmatdyt hospital, genetics reagents including Illumina DNA Prep with Exome, which is library prep, not sequencer reagents) and UA-2023-05-18-004582-a (Gromashevsky Institute, 4 reagent items, no Illumina link seen). I did not open either tender page. I found no NovaSeq 6000 vs X kit mix, no unit prices and no bidder counts. Ukraine is also a small, war-distorted market, so even complete data would carry little weight for the thesis.
how_to_mine: Not recommended. If pursued, use an aggregator with a text search (dozorro.org, or the Prozorro 'Bi' open-data portal at bi.prozorro.org). Search 'NovaSeq' and 'Illumina', filter to 2023-26, then open each tender's items table for unit price and quantity. Alternatively, open the two tender pages above to check their line items. Expect few or no relevant hits.
new_candidates: Taiwan PCC and other open-data procurement portals that support keyword search (the Prozorro API does not)
Brazil ComprasNet/PNCP, Mexico CompraNet and Colombia SECOP II, whose open data has searchable item-level unit prices for Illumina flow cells
